_comment: Custom tool schemas for the OnDuty Agent sales receptionist. All POST, args_at_root true, timeout 120000. Replace every [BRACKET] before importing. After ANY change here, diff the parameter lists against docs/sales-agent/PROMPT.txt — prompt/schema drift is the most common bug in these builds.

book_demo.name: book_demo
book_demo.execution_message_description: Okay, I'm booking that for you now.

startTime.description: ISO8601 with offset taken from current_time, e.g. 2026-10-02T14:00:00-04:00. Never hardcode the offset.

endTime.description: startTime plus 15 minutes, same ISO8601 format and offset.

description.description: Pipe delimited in exactly this order: +1XXXXXXXXXX | email | business name | industry | what they said their phone problem is

caller_name.description: Full name of the person booking.

caller_email.description: lowercase name@domain.com, confirmed with the caller before sending.

industry.description: Their industry. Use Other for anything not on the list.

current_setup.description: Who answers their phone today, and what happens after hours. Unknown if not discussed.

pain_point.description: The problem in their own words. None if they never named one.

objections_raised.description: What they pushed back on: price, robot concerns, timing, incumbent vendor. None if no objection.

urgency.description: High if they are actively losing calls now or shopping vendors this week.

one_line_summary.description: One sentence a human can scan in a list.

detailed_summary.description: Enough for whoever takes the demo to prep without listening to the recording.

check_availability_cal.note: Retell's built-in Cal.com check. Needs the Cal.com API key, event_type_id [CAL_EVENT_TYPE_ID] for a 15-minute demo, and timezone America/New_York. Must be OnDuty Agent's OWN event type — do not reuse a client build's. Connect that Cal.com event to the same Google Calendar the n8n booking flow writes to, or availability will be wrong.

transfer_call.handoff_prompt: Say hello to the team member and briefly summarize who is calling, what business they run, and what they need.
transfer_call.note: BLOCKED — OnDuty Agent publishes no phone number, so there is no transfer destination configured. Either supply a number or delete this tool and remove the TRANSFERS section from the prompt. Do not ship a transfer tool that dials nowhere.

end_call.note: Invoked last, after the single goodbye line. Never before call_summary.
